title: Explain alignment with GDPR, the EHDS and MyHealth@EU
requirements:
- Name the EHDS Regulation and MyHealth@EU where cross-border and regional exchange is discussed
- Reference GDPR and EHDS and map relevant DPI-H components to EHDS obligations and formats
- Note that where a regional legal framework applies, its requirements shape national component specification
- Distinguish current operational services from planned EHDS obligations and secondary use, with dates
